# Colecto v0.8.1

Settings can now go back to their defaults, and drafts, labels, API keys and send
approvals get their own place in the database. Your data from v0.8.0 moves over by itself.

## Reset to defaults

- **Appearance → Text** and **Notifications → How they appear** show a reset button
  once you change something there. Setting groups from extensions, such as the mailbox
  options in Appearance, have one too.
- A reset forgets your choice instead of saving the current default, so when a later
  release improves a default, you get it.

## Storage

- Drafts, labels, API keys and send approvals each have their own table instead of one
  stored document each, so saving one draft or using one key no longer rewrites the rest.
- On first start, v0.8.1 copies your database to `colecto.db.before-v1` and converts
  it. Nothing to do on your side. As with every beta update, an older Colecto cannot
  open the database afterwards. See
  [Storage](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.8.1/docs/storage.md).

## For API users

- `GET` and `POST /api/v1/preferences` also return `changed`, the setting keys you
  changed.
- `POST /api/v1/extensions/{id}/settings/reset` with `{"keys": […]}` returns an
  extension's settings to their defaults (owner only). The extension API is unchanged.
